text:
Ava: Alert — hosted-infer.usw2 p99 latency + 5xx spike starting ~11:03 UTC. SLO burn alarm fired.
Miguel: on it, pulling traces + logs now.
Priya: getting customer escalations — several complaining about timeouts/5xx on generation API.
Ava: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/team/sre/d/infra/hosted-infer?panel=5 — large spike in 5xx and p99; most 5xx are 502/504 at gateway.
Sam: quick glance at traces: many requests stop at gateway/auth call -> no downstream spans. trace sampling looks fine but headers dropped maybe.
Priya: support notes show errors like "upstream auth timeout" and a repeated billing metadata fetch failure.
Miguel: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T11:04:05Z infer-proxy[pid=2145]: ERROR txn=abcd1234 upstream=/v1/internal/metadata timeout=5.001s err="context deadline exceeded"
2026-03-15T11:04:06Z auth-service[pid=332]: WARN token-exchange id=abcd1234 err="remote billing lookup failed"
```
Ava: deploy-bot notes: rollout infer-proxy v2.14 -> 10:58 UTC, change: enable-metadata-cache=false (attempting fresh metadata per-request).
deploy-bot: Rollout finished: infer-proxy:v2.14 @ 2026-03-15T10:58:12Z
Miguel: if cache disabled, we're hammering billing/metadata endpoint on every request — that explains spike + increased tail latency and some timeouts.
Sam: reproduction curl (simulating no-cache):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
 -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","input":"hi"}' --max-time 6
# many requests hit /v1/internal/metadata and sometimes timeout at ~5s
```
Priya: impacted customers: CUST-112, CUST-204 (reserved capacity), several on-hosted API. Support tickets opened.
Ava: immediate mitigations: 1) revert rollout to v2.13 2) re-enable server-side metadata cache 3) increase metadata call timeout to 10s while we stabilize.
Miguel: running log query to measure scope:
```
logs.query("service:infer-proxy AND path:/v1/internal/metadata AND level:ERROR AND timestamp:[now-30m TO now]")
# -> ~3.2k errors in last 10m, top upstream timeout routes: billing-service
```
Sam: tracing gap root cause: v2.14 proxy dropped x-cloud-trace-context for internal fetches. downstream services don't attach spans if header missing.
Ava: can we confirm header behavior in code? Priya: I see a middleware change: strip-internal-headers=true by default in v2.14 config.
Miguel: rolling back now. Reverting to infer-proxy:v2.13 @ 11:12 UTC.
ops-bot: Rollback triggered by user miguel — infer-proxy:v2.14 -> v2.13 (deploy id: dpl-4492)
Priya: after rollback, 5xx rate already trending down in graphs (11:18 UTC). customers still seeing intermittent failures for a few minutes due to in-flight requests.
Sam: follow-ups:
- add guard in rollout checklists to run synthetic metadata probe before flipping cache off
- add retry+exponential-backoff for metadata fetches in proxy
- ensure trace headers are preserved for internal calls
Ava: immediate action items:
- miguel: postmortem + dashboard panel with metadata error rate (due EOD)
- priya: customer comms + joint timeline for affected tenants
- sam: add synthetic probe + alert for metadata endpoint latency (SLO 99.9% < 200ms)
- ava: open infra ticket to add dedicated caching layer for billing metadata
Miguel: preliminary root cause: v2.14 removed metadata cache + stripped trace header -> huge increase in synchronous remote calls to billing endpoint, causing timeouts and downstream trace gaps.
Priya: noting billing-service had a short GC pause around 11:05 which amplified failures — adding that to timeline.
Ava: ok, closing pager for now since rollback successful. We'll track follow-ups in #postmortems and schedule a canary with synthetic load before any future cache toggles. :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks everyone, I'll send initial customer update.
Miguel: I'll open the postmortem and link queries + PR diffs.
Sam: reassigning follow-ups in linear. small note: add regression test to CI to ensure trace headers survive internal proxy calls.
Ava: great work, closing thread. :white_check_mark:
